_comment: The browser image (R4e): fleet/vm/image.json plus what is here. bin/fleet-vm-image browser merges the two (packages and copy entries are added, commands run after the base image's). Agents with vm_image: browser in agent.yaml get it. cdt (fleet/vm/shot/cdt) drives the same Chromium interactively through chrome-devtools-axi, with chrome-devtools-mcp pinned to 1.7.0 (the bridge asks for @latest, and 1.10+ requires a pageId that chrome-devtools-axi 0.1.29 does not send).
